mutations.name: the record drops the low-tier decision
kills: the merge evidence of a low-tier policy touch the record carries the low-tier decision beside the risk tier

mutations.name: every PR records a low-tier decision
kills: the merge evidence of a low-tier policy touch a PR with no policy path records no low-tier decision

mutations.name: every hold class requires the adversary's attestation
kills: the merge evidence of a low-tier policy touch a low-tier run's claimed row is met by the correctness MERGE alone

mutations.name: no hold class requires the adversary's attestation
kills: the merge evidence of a low-tier policy touch the same claim under an adversary hold still wants the adversary
